title: Coordinate scalar compatibility of explicit affine stalk transport
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], x a point, and U an affine open containing x. Put A=Gamma(Y,U) and q=isoSpec(x). For an O_Y-module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], an A-module M, and a model isomorphism e:F|U -> tilde(M)|U [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], construct E:(tilde M)_q -> F_x as the inverse chart restriction-stalk isomorphism, the stalk of e inverse, then the open inclusion restriction-stalk isomorphism. E is an additive equivalence. For every a in A and m in (tilde M)_q, E(a*m)=germ_U,x(a)*E(m), using the canonical A-action on the tilde stalk and the local-ring action [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] on F_x.

source.place: Lemma 26.5.4 (7); Tag 01BH, Lemma 17.10.5 (3); transport along open immersion stalk maps

proof.text: For an open immersion j, inverse_stalkMap_germ computes the inverse stalk ring map on a section germ using appIso_inv_app_assoc and germ_res_apply. For restriction_stalk_smul, represent the scalar and module element on a common neighbourhood, use the restriction-stalk germ formula, and apply PresheafOfModules.germ_smul; the restricted section scalar action is definitionally the action through the inverse section-ring map. Bijectivity gives restriction_stalk_inv_smul. The middle factor is the proved Scheme.Modules.Hom.stalkLinearMap of e.inv. chart_scalar_germ identifies the composite chart and inclusion scalar map with the germ of a, using isoSpec_hom_appTop and germ_stalkMap_apply. Finally the canonical A-action on the tilde stalk is definitionally the action through StructureSheaf.toStalk. Composing the inverse chart, linear middle factor, and inclusion identities proves the formula, without finite generation, flatness, or quasi-coherence hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem affineModelStalkAddEquiv_smul
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (x : Y) (U : Y.affineOpens) (hx : x ∈ U.1)
    (F : Y.Modules) (M : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1))
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom).obj (tilde M))
    (a : Γ(Y, U.1)) (m : (tilde M).presheaf.stalk (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩)) :
    affineModelStalkAddEquiv x U hx F M e (a • m) =
      Y.presheaf.germ U.1 x hx a • affineModelStalkAddEquiv x U hx F M e m
